name: codemo
description: Codemo Digital Nomad - GitHub Repository Web File Browser, File Preview, Folder Download and Web Apps

paragraphs: A versatile collection of web apps designed for developers and creatives on the go. Features include a live code playground, vector graphic creator and editor, and a powerful file browser to preview, edit, and download individual files or entire directories as ZIP archives. Built with offline-first capabilities using localStorage for user-configurable settings, enabling full customization and portability. Ideal for local development, demos, and lightweight desktop-like experiences — all running entirely in the browser.
